selection_order: Analysis rule written after reading the paper and dataset description, before downloading or inspecting numerical CSV outcomes; retrospective public-data analysis, not prospective preregistration.
primary_observable: Complex characteristic function of the conditionally prepared oscillator, measured with separate binary qubit readouts
model_relation: chi(u+i*v) = chi(u) * chi(i*v), for a Gaussian state with zero Q-P covariance
preparation_family: Supplied Gaussian preparation, allowing unknown means and diagonal quadrature variances; no fit to off-axis outcomes

grid.independently_scored_indices: Nonnegative quadrant only; axes calibrate, strictly off-axis entries validate
grid.orientation_rule: Infer row versus column imaginary-coordinate axis only from exact published reflection/conjugation redundancy, never by residual minimization; reject ambiguous structure

statistical_diagnostic.method: Simultaneous Hoeffding boxes for bounded spin means, then exact complex interval-product propagation
statistical_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic under the declared sampling and no-additional-bias assumptions, not a certified apparatus budget or unconditional significance
